correctness.rationale: For the regular age density \(\rho(a)=6a(L-a)/L^3\), Grönwall gives \(|w_t^b|\le B\). Because \(\rho(0)=\rho(L)=0\) and \(\|\rho'\|_{L^1}=3/L\), differentiating the age-weighted aggregate gives \(|K'|\le3B/L+MB+\eta_0+\kappa\). The positive family \(K_\omega(t)=1+(1/2)\sin(\omega t)\) has derivative norm \(\omega/2\), so no fixed finite bound can cover every \(\omega\).
